top_signals.title: Russian pizza chain with 1,500 locations confirms cyberattack following hacker claims
top_signals.summary: According to Dodo Pizza, the potentially compromised information included customers’ names, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth and order details.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Jamie Dimon has a plan to revive the West: A 'big, beautiful' deal with Europe
top_signals.summary: "Many of the current disputes between Europe and the U.S. are minor compared with this agreement's size and benefits," the JPMorgan boss wrote this week.
